colors.usage_rules: Use gold (#CFA935) for highlights, buttons, key words.

typography.notes: Headlines in Montserrat, subheadings in Montserrat Medium, body in Poppins. Important keywords in gold (#CFA935).

voice.writing_style: Short, high-impact statements with gold highlights. Use real, human-focused storytelling.
voice.target_audience: Professionals looking to upskill and certify in AI technologies.

hints.instagram: Use carousel posts with a size of 1080x1080px, ensuring the logo is always top-left.
hints.linkedin: Focus on professional tone and high-quality imagery with strong CTAs.

text_preferences.hashtag_style: Branded and professional, up to 5 per post.
text_preferences.caption_style: Concise and impactful, with a strong CTA.

generation.governance_prompt_template: Always adhere to AI CERTs guidelines. Use #CFA935 for highlights, rectangle buttons with round edges, and display the logo in the top-left. Apply Open Sans and Montserrat for text, with professional, educational, and industry-expert tone. Ensure high-quality imagery with modern tech visuals and dark gradients.
generation.design_guidelines: Use circular/rounded icons, dark gradients with Navy and Gold, and clean white backgrounds for concept explanations.
generation.layout_spacing_rules: Image spacing should be 80px on all sides.
generation.cta_button_rules: Rectangle buttons with round edges in golden or white with black border. Typical texts: 'Enroll Now', 'Book Your Seat'.
generation.visual_style_rules: Dark modern gradients, high-quality professional imagery, modern tech visuals, and glowing spheres.
generation.avoid_rules: Avoid using unauthorized colors and fonts. Do not place the logo anywhere but top-left.
generation.slide_intro_template: Presenting AI CERTs: Innovate and Certify for Tomorrow
generation.slide_user_prompt_suffix: Remember: Gold highlights and a strong CTA are crucial.
